componentSet.name: Typography / Text
componentSet.description: Body text and utility typography components with Bootstrap semantic text colors. Includes all Bootstrap 5.3 text utility color variants (.text-primary, .text-success, etc.) for conveying meaning through color. Features body text, lead paragraphs, small text, links, and emphasis variants with proper WCAG-compliant colors for light mode.

defaultStyles.label: This is body text in the default color for readable content.

styles.label: This is body text in the default color for readable content.

variants.description: Default body text (1rem / 16px) with .text-body - Standard paragraph text color (gray-900). Use for all main content, articles, and readable text. Line height of 1.5 meets WCAG AA standards.

styles.label: This is body text in primary emphasis color for brand-aligned content.

variants.description: Body text with .text-primary-emphasis - Primary brand color (blue-700, shade 60%). Use for text that needs brand emphasis or primary CTAs. Higher contrast than standard primary for better readability.

styles.label: This is body text in secondary muted color for supporting information.

variants.description: Body text with .text-secondary - Muted secondary color (gray-600). Use for captions, labels, helper text, or less prominent supporting information. Meets WCAG AA for body text.

styles.label: This is body text in tertiary light color for subtle supporting text.

variants.description: Body text with .text-tertiary - Tertiary text color (gray-500). Use for even lighter text, placeholder-like content, or the least important supporting information.

styles.label: This is body text in success color for positive feedback and confirmations.

variants.description: Body text with .text-success-emphasis - Success color emphasis (green-700). Use for success messages, positive feedback, confirmations, or completed states. Conveys positive outcomes and achievements.

styles.label: This is body text in danger color for errors and critical warnings.

variants.description: Body text with .text-danger-emphasis - Danger color emphasis (red-700). Use for error messages, form validation errors, critical alerts, or destructive action warnings. Ensures users recognize problems.

styles.label: This is body text in warning color for caution messages and alerts.

variants.description: Body text with .text-warning-emphasis - Warning color emphasis (yellow-700). Use for cautions, important notices, pending states, or messages requiring user attention. Higher contrast than standard warning.

styles.label: This is body text in info color for informational content and tips.

variants.description: Body text with .text-info-emphasis - Info color emphasis (cyan-700). Use for informational content, tips, help text, tooltips, or neutral notifications. Communicates helpful information without urgency.

styles.label: This is body text in light emphasis color for subtle contrast.

variants.description: Body text with .text-light-emphasis - Light emphasis color (gray-700). Use for subtle text on light backgrounds, providing moderate contrast while maintaining readability.

styles.label: This is body text in dark emphasis color for maximum contrast.

variants.description: Body text with .text-dark-emphasis - Dark emphasis color (gray-900). Use for maximum contrast text, ensuring highest readability. WCAG AAA compliant on light backgrounds.

styles.label: This is a lead paragraph that stands out from regular text. It uses larger size and lighter weight for visual hierarchy and improved readability.

variants.description: Lead paragraph with .lead (1.25rem / 20px) - Make a paragraph stand out with larger font size and lighter weight (300). Use for introductory text, article summaries, or emphasized content. Enhanced line height (1.75) for readability.

styles.label: This is a lead paragraph in primary emphasis color. Perfect for introductory content with brand emphasis.

variants.description: Lead paragraph with .text-primary-emphasis - Combines lead paragraph styling with primary brand color. Perfect for hero section subheadings or brand-aligned introductory text.

styles.label: Small text for secondary information, captions, or helper text.

variants.description: Small text with <small> or .small (0.875rem / 14px) - Use for fine print, captions, legal text, timestamps, or secondary supporting information. Line height 1.25 optimized for compact display.

styles.label: Small muted text for less important information or captions.

variants.description: Small text with .text-muted - Combines small size with muted secondary color (gray-600). Use for metadata, timestamps, copyright notices, or information requiring minimal visual weight.

styles.label: inline code snippet

variants.description: Inline code with <code> - Monospace font (Roboto Mono) with pink accent color. Use for inline code snippets, variable names, function names, or technical terms within paragraphs.

styles.label: This is a text link for navigation or references.

variants.description: Default link color with <a> or .link-* (blue-600) - Standard hyperlink color for all interactive text and navigation. Provides clear visual indication of clickable content.

styles.label: This is a text link in hover state.

variants.description: Link hover state (blue-700) - Darker shade for :hover and :focus states. Provides visual feedback for interactive links, improving usability and accessibility.

styles.label: Bold emphasis text for strong importance.

variants.description: Bold text with <strong>, <b>, or .fw-bold (700 weight) - Use for strong emphasis, important keywords, or content requiring immediate attention. Conveys importance through weight.

styles.label: Semibold text for medium emphasis.

variants.description: Semibold text with .fw-semibold (600 weight) - Medium emphasis between normal and bold. Use for subheadings within body text, labels, or moderate emphasis without full bold weight.

styles.label: Light weight text for subtle de-emphasis.

variants.description: Light text with .fw-light (300 weight) - Lighter weight for subtle de-emphasis or elegant typography. Use in lead paragraphs, display text, or content requiring refined appearance.
